title: Reel 2 begins with Alfred on saxophone players in his California band
summary: On a new reel, Allen asks Alfred about saxophonists such as Red Spikes who played in his California band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Let's see, this is Bob Watts' Reel 2. It's May the, I keep saying May, February 28th, 1963. Since you're here, this is Alfred Williams, I wanted to ask you, you say you had some saxophone players with Orion in California when you were out there? Yeah, Red Spikes played, you see, Red played Tether. That's the tall fella. Red played with us. I don't, I think.
